blocks.html:
The old flow is emptying out, not switched off

Post-Purchase Onboarding (RETIRING) is still marked live, and on purpose. Its first step now sends every new entrant down a path that goes nowhere, so nobody new gets into it, while everyone already partway through finishes the sequence they started. Switching it off outright would have cut those people off mid-journey.

So the old band on the chart below is not a second journey running alongside the new one. It is the queue draining. It should fall away over the next few weeks as the last people in it reach the end, and the day it hits zero is the day the handover is genuinely finished.

blocks.title: Each flow since the switch

blocks.html:
What changed

Until 5 October one flow handled everything after a purchase, and it started the moment the order was placed. Every email after that was counted off a clock that had nothing to do with where the parcel actually was. Three flows replace it, each tied to something that really happened:

  • Pre-Order: The Wait fires when a pre-order is placed, and keeps people warm until the stock lands.
  • Onboarding fires when the order is fulfilled, so the sequence starts when the parcel is genuinely on its way.
  • Delivered fires when the courier marks the parcel delivered, which is the only honest moment to ask someone how they like it.

The clock moved. The old flow measured from the order. The new ones measure from dispatch and delivery. "Day 14" is a different moment in each, so do not line the two sequences up email by email.

The creative mostly did not change. Eleven of the new Onboarding emails are the same emails, moved across. If open rate moves, the first suspect is timing and audience, not the writing.

Pre-orders are a different population. They were a small share of orders over the last month, so the Pre-Order flow will always look small next to the others. Small is correct. It is not underperforming.

The old flow was retired, not deleted. Its emails stay in the account so the history stays readable, and it keeps running for the people already inside it. Its band shrinking to nothing is the point.

Two flows are excluded. A part-shipment variant and a split-orders variant were built but never switched on. They are left out of every number here.
